query:
select (
             exists(select 1 from item where base_unit_id = $1 and deleted_at is null)
             or exists(
                 select 1
                 from item_unit_conversion c
                 join item i on i.id = c.item_id
                 where c.unit_id = $1 and c.deleted_at is null and i.deleted_at is null
             )
           ) as "in_use!"
